'''Jed''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] with his [[Jed's wife|wife]] and daughters during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The [[Twin Suns (pirates)|Twin Suns]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang kidnapped the whole family, though Republic-allied individuals sent by Jed's friend [[Danbar Hue]] and rescued them and other captive farmers in the [[Twin Sun pirates base|pirate base]].<ref name="TOR:SaR" />
